question: What characterizes the arisen Netrodyota as filled with supreme nondual nectar?
premises: It is described as swollen with supreme nondual nectar
It is said to have arisen
inference: This Netrodyota has arisen full of the nectar of supreme nonduality.
plain_english: This Netrodyota, swollen with the nectar of supreme nonduality, has arisen.
